title: Tenant midnight-safe cutover for reserved-capacity quota resets (timezone & DST aware)
creator: Marisol Chen
description: Problem: Reserved-capacity customers expect daily and monthly quota resets to occur at their local midnight anchor (or a configured billing anchor). Our current reset pipeline assumes UTC/month-boundary anchors and occasionally causes double-billing, unexpected short months, or early/late resets when tenants are migrated between regions or during DST transitions. This ticket ships a robust, timezone-aware cutover that preserves correctness for reserved pools and avoids brief over/under-allocation during rollovers.
design_notes: High-level approach: introduce per-tenant 'billing_anchor' (tz-aware) with an immutable anchor history and a transient cutover safety window. The reset reconciler will: 1) compute tenant local cutover instant using stored tz database (IANA zone) and current DST rules; 2) create a temporary grace ledger entry (cutover_grace) that defers hard enforcement for N minutes and records a provisional delta; 3) run a compensating reconciliation job after grace window that applies final debits/credits and emits audit trail events. Key invariants: idempotent resets, monotonic usage ledger, and observable cutover traces for SRE/Support. We choose a ledger-based approach (instead of immediate destructive delta) to simplify rollback and auditability.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant resets occur at local midnight as configured (IANA tz) with no more than configured grace_delay (default 15m)
No tenant sees more than one full reset in a 24h span except during explicit admin migrations
Audit entries include: original_anchor_time_utc, computed_local_midnight, grace_window_start/end, final_reconciliation_id
Automated migration script migrates existing tenants with anchor=UTC to explicit tz entries without changing effective reset time
End-to-end tests validate DST forward/backward transitions (US, EU, Australia examples)
Latency impact of reconciler < 5% increase for peak reserved-pool reconciliation jobs
implementation_plan: Schema: add tenant.billing_anchor {type: 'tz|fixed-offset'} and tenant.anchor_history (append-only list of anchor changes)
API: admin endpoint to set anchor and preview next N cutovers; validate IANA tz strings
Runtime: update reset reconciler to compute cutover instant using tzinfo library (time zone database bundled)
Grace ledger: implement cutover_grace row type that records provisional token balances and expires after grace_delay
Reconciler batch job: second-phase reconciler that applies final ledger adjustments and emits audit events
Observability: add cutover traces to Console (per-tenant timeline) and SLO metric for 'missed cutovers'
Backfill: run a one-time migration to populate billing_anchor for all tenants and create anchor_history entries
migration_plan: Phase 1: Soft migration - populate tenant.billing_anchor from inferred timezone (based on org profile/region). Mark migrated tenants with anchor_migrated=true. Phase 2: Rollout grace windows by default (15m) and monitor 'missed cutover' metric. Phase 3: Enable hard enforcement after 2-week observation and manual whitelisting for customers who require custom cutover. Provide a one-click rollback that replays ledger deltas to revert last cutover for a single tenant.
test_plan: Unit tests for tz conversion and cutover instant computation (edge cases: DST start/end, leap seconds simulated)
Integration test: simulate tenant with reserved pool, drive usage across local-midnight boundary, assert single reset and ledger state
Chaos test: simulate delayed reconciler and confirm idempotence and no double-billing
Load test: run reconciler at scale on staging with synthetic tenants across 24 timezones to measure latency and memory
Manual QA: run checklists with Support for customer-facing messaging and run preview endpoint with real tenant anchors
rollout_plan: Canary rollout to 5% of reserved-capacity tenants (prefer low-risk tenants) for 3 days, monitor missed_cutover, ledger_discrepancy_rate, and support tickets. If metrics stable, expand to 50% then 100% over 10 days. Provide feature flag to disable per-tenant anchor and revert to UTC during emergency.
